tools.name: where_am_i
tools.description: Describe the user's current Yandex Practicum page: page kind (profile, theory lesson, trainer), lesson and task with their solved status, and which actions are available right now. Call this first and after anything unexpected.

tools.name: get_progress
tools.description: Study progress of the profession: without arguments, the list of courses with solved-lesson counts; with course (number or part of the name), its topics and lessons numbered course.topic.lesson (e.g. 5.1.3) with solved marks.

course.description: course number from the list, or part of its name

tools.name: read_lesson
tools.description: Read a lesson as text, including parts the page still hides. Interactive blocks are marked [q1 …], [q2 …] with their options and whether they are answered. Without lesson, reads the lesson open in the tab. Reading does not open the lesson or mark anything.

lesson.description: lesson position like 5.1.3 (from get_progress) or lesson id; default: the current lesson

offset.description: for long lessons: continue from this character (the output says when)

tools.name: read_task
tools.description: The current code-trainer task: description, task number, solved status, project files, number of hints and the deployed preview URL if any.

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: The code currently in the trainer editor (including unsaved edits). For multi-file projects pass file, e.g. homepage/views.py; a file that isn't open is opened in the editor first.

file.description: file path in the project; default: the file shown in the editor

tools.name: open_lesson
tools.description: Open a lesson in the user's tab and wait until it has loaded. Opening a lesson marks it as visited on the platform.

lesson.description: lesson position like 5.1.3 (from get_progress) or lesson id

tools.name: go_home
tools.description: Go to the profession's main (profile) page with the course overview.

tools.name: complete_lesson
tools.description: On a theory lesson, press the button at the bottom ("К следующему уроку" marks the lesson solved and opens the next one; "Перейти к заданию" opens the practice tasks). Fails and lists the blocks still unanswered if the button isn't available yet. Asks the user first.

tools.name: press_action_button
tools.description: Press a button block of the current lesson (shown by read_lesson as [qN · button …]); it reveals the content after it. Asks the user first.

block.description: block ref from read_lesson, e.g. q1

tools.name: answer_quiz
tools.description: Answer a quiz block of the current lesson through the page, submit it and return what the page shows (correct/incorrect, explanations). Most quizzes allow ONE attempt, so read the lesson first. Answer format, using read_lesson's numbering: single/multiple choice: option numbers "2" or "1, 3"; matching, card sorting and connect-the-items: pairs "1=B; 2=A; 3=C" covering every item; free text: the text itself. Asks the user first.

block.description: block ref from read_lesson, e.g. q2

answer.description: the answer in the format above

retry.description: answer again a quiz that allows retries (matching, card sorting)

tools.name: set_code
tools.description: Replace the whole content of a file in the trainer editor with code. For multi-file projects pass file (it is opened in the file tree if needed). The user can undo with Ctrl+Z.

file.description: file path in the project, e.g. homepage/views.py; default: the file shown in the editor

tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Run the program in the editor without checking it (Python tasks) and return exit code, stdout and stderr. Retries the platform's own errors.

tools.name: check_task
tools.description: Submit the code for checking and return whether the task is solved and the checker's message. Each check counts as an attempt. Retries the platform's own errors. Asks the user first.

tools.name: show_hint
tools.description: Show the next hint of the current trainer task (or hint number N).

number.description: which hint, starting at 1; default: the next one

tools.name: next_task
tools.description: Go to the next trainer task (button «Далее», available after the task is solved; on the last task it opens the next lesson) or the previous one.

tools.name: deploy
tools.description: Web projects: deploy the current files to a preview server and wait until it runs. Retries the platform's own errors.

tools.name: fetch_preview
tools.description: Web projects: GET a page of the deployed preview site and return the HTTP status and HTML.

tools.name: ask_platform_ai
tools.description: Ask the site's own assistant (Практикум ИИ) a question in the chat of the current lesson or task, wait for its full answer and return it (Russian Markdown) with suggested follow-ups. The assistant already knows the current lesson. Adds to the user's chat history, so it asks the user first.

question.description: the question, as the user would type it
